    for i in range(8):
        out=os.path.join(d,'out.bin'); res=os.path.join(d,'restored.txt')
        r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'compress.py','corpus.txt',out], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)

        r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'compress.py','--decompress',out,res], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)

        score=100*(1-os.path.getsize(out)/c)
